images.status: RULED OUT this pass (bUNT4, 25 Sept 2026): two crowned/allegorical figures each holding a tablet -- does not match Herzog 1929's Bild 2 (a single figure at a rock/cave with a chapel and pine trees) or the six-line inscription's arch-framed rock-tablet layout confirmed at opening 11 below. Kept on disk as a ruled-out candidate, not deleted, since it may be Herzog's separate 'fol. 27' comparandum inscription mentioned in his footnote apparatus (not yet checked -- see NOTES.md).

images.foliation_visible: pencil pagination '20' (top-left, left/verso page) and '21' (bottom, right/recto page) -- consistent with Herzog 1929's own foliation of this same manuscript as 'fol. 10\'' (verso) / 'fol. 11' (recto): pencil page = 2x Herzog folio number for a verso, 2x+1 for a recto.
images.content: CONFIRMED MATCH to Herzog 1929's Bild 2/fol. 10'-11 (see NOTES.md 'Leaf identified' section): left page shows the six-line inscription painted as text inside an arch-topped frame drawn on a red rock tablet (matching Herzog's footnote d, p.29: 'Die Inschrift wird nach oben hin von einem Bogen eingerahmt' -- the inscription is framed above by an arch), with a standing figure pointing at/copying the tablet and a seated armed figure beside it; right page continues the narrative prose, which reads almost word-for-word against Herzog's printed text for fol. 11 ('Und wie ich solang geschaut und abgeschriben hab, in dem ist es Abend worden...'). NOT independently transcribed here per brief scope ('do not transcribe' -- a later blind pass will).
